To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the present analysis is a useful tool for the study of parametric instability of rotating shells under periodic axial forces and that the instability region of rotating cylindrical shells can be enlarged by applying a suitable axial load.
the parametric instability regions are obtained for rotating cylindrical shells subjected time dependent periodic axial loading.
the parametric stability analysis of rotating cylindrical shells is carried out by employing Donnell type linear equations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new parametric instability problem of rotating cylindrical shells.
the parametric instability of rotating thin cylindrical shells under static or time dependent periodic axial loading.
a comprehensive study of the stability of rotating cylindrical shell under periodic axial loads.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the parametric instability regions for rotating shells under periodic axial forces are much larger than those for non rotating shells.
the parametric instability regions for rotating thin cylindrical shells are much wider than those of non-rotating shells.
the parametric instability region of rotating cylindrical shells is very narrow, but it may be enlarged under some conditions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the present analysis can be applied to the design of rotating cylindrical shells for the aerospace and marine structures.
parametric instability of rotating thin cylindrical shells under time periodic axial loads can be effectively predicted by using the present analysis.
the parametric instability of rotating circular cylindrical shells subjected to axial periodic loads can be predicted using the present method.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the parametric instability of rotating shells under periodic axial forces can be effectively suppressed by increasing circumferential wave numbers, increasing static axial loads, increasing shell length to radius ratios or decreasing thickness to radius ratios.
it is important to take into consideration the influence of the axial loading on the dynamic instability of rotating cylindrical shell.

the parametric instability of rotating shells is a complicated problem and it is very important to consider the influences of circumfrential wave number and viscous damping on the stability of rotating cylindrical shell.
